applicabilityBasis.summary: mHYPER is a NAV-accreting tokenized investment product structured as a Midas blockchain-based certificate/debt instrument, not a fixed-value payment stablecoin. Its value tracks a market-neutral strategy and the Midas prospectus excludes U.S. persons; the GENIUS payment-stablecoin perimeter is therefore not the right authorization track.

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein FMA (prospectus-approving authority under the EU Prospectus Regulation; Midas Software GmbH is not FMA-licensed)
genius.notes: mHYPER is a Midas NAV-accreting, yield-bearing blockchain-based certificate/debt instrument tracking Hyperithm market-neutral stablecoin strategies, not a fixed-value payment stablecoin. The Liechtenstein FMA prospectus approval is a securities-prospectus approval, not a MiCA or GENIUS issuer authorization; Midas documentation also excludes U.S. persons. No GENIUS approval/application/foreign-exception registration was assessed because the asset is an excluded security.
